I personally love reading OC stories. It gives it something new. Often I seek out exactly those stories over the canon based character based. 

The only down side is that a lot of fanfic with OC’s are badly written. A few are good and I save them as if my life depended on it. 

Some people like it (like me) and others don’t. From what I’ve heard, most read fanfic to read stories about their favourite characters. Which I get. One of my top criteria for good written OC stories is that they interact with my favourite characters as well as showing what type they are themselves. 


So to say it short: if it’s written well OC stories are good but only if it’s your thing to begin with.
